Expert Library Plus Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of Expert Library Plus Skill for installing and managing an AI expert library system.
- Provides support for 43+ expert personas with quality enhancement via name-based anchoring.
- Enables installation, verification, backup/rollback, and custom name library creation for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Features comprehensive error handling, conflict detection, and both automated/manual installation options.
- Offers step-by-step usage instructions, sample prompts, and best practices for expert library management.
